name: Chris
text: I am the man with the violin case. In my defence, the video was very convincing.

name: Nadia, club coach
text: Point 5 every single time. My adults get one hour a week with me and nothing else, then ask why their match play is nervy. You can't drill your way to being comfortable in a match.

author: jake
text: Point 5 is the one I'd underline. The quickest fix I've seen is a club [ladder on Rallio](https://rallio.io/ladders/): everyone can see who's near them, challenge from their phone and get a match that week, against someone roughly their level. Costs a lot less than £300.

author: mel
text: Terry has had the same racket since 2004 and it is HELD TOGETHER WITH TAPE. Just so everyone knows!!
